attributes.name: Arboreal Armor
attributes.powers:
Reveal this card to reduce Combat damage dealt to you by 1, or by 2 if the check has the Swashbuckling trait. 

Discard this card to reduce all damage except Fire damage dealt to you to 0; if proficient with light armors, recharge it instead. 

If proficient with light armors, you may recharge this card when you reset your hand.
